# Fig 3B

-   ATAC *Gene Activity* score per cluster for marker genes

## ARC

```{R}

mark_ge <- c("Npy","Ccbe1","Dach2","Tmem26","Pomc",
             "Sntb1","Vgll3","Tcf7l2","Sv2b","Hydin","Mcc",
             "Col24a1","Pdgfd","Colec12","Lmo7","Megf11","Nfib","Qrfpr","Alk",
             "Pdzrn3","Gem","Sim1","Bnc2","Sema3e","Unc13c","Lef1","Lhx9","Rgs6")

```

```{R, fig3B.ARC.ATAC.dotplot, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, dev=c('png', 'pdf'), eval=F}

seu_arc <- subset(ARC, tech=="ATAC")
count <- GetAssayData(seu_arc, assay = "RNA",slot = "data")
count <- as.matrix(count)

meta_rna <- seu_arc@meta.data

clust_share <- unique(seu_arc$cluster)

calPlot_list <- lapply(mark_ge, function(ge, mat, clust, meta){
  
  exp <- mat[ge,]
  
  exp_list <- lapply(clust, function(x, exp, meta2){
    cell_sel <- rownames(meta2)[meta2$cluster==x]
    ex <- exp[cell_sel]
    to <- length(exp)
    pos <- length(ex[ex > 0])
    med <- mean(ex)
    res <- setNames(c(med,(pos/to)*100),c("exp","prop"))
    return(res)}, exp, meta)
  
  names(exp_list) <- clust
  
  exp_mat <- do.call(rbind, exp_list)
  exp_dat <- data.frame(gene=ge,cluster=rownames(exp_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  exp_dat <- cbind(exp_dat,exp_mat)
  return(exp_dat)}, 
  count, clust_share, meta_rna)

names(calPlot_list) <- mark_ge
calPlot_dat <- do.call(rbind,calPlot_list)

calPlot_dat$cluster <- factor(calPlot_dat$cluster,levels = sort(as.numeric(as.vector(unique(calPlot_dat$cluster)))))
calPlot_dat$gene <- factor(calPlot_dat$gene, levels = unique(calPlot_dat$gene))

ggplot(calPlot_dat, aes(x=gene, y=cluster, size=prop, color=exp)) + geom_point() +
    labs(x="", y="Clusters", color="avg_exp", size="Percent") +
    scale_color_gradient(low="white", high = "darkblue") +
    theme_classic() + coord_flip()

```

```{R, fig3B.ARC.ATAC.heatmap, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, dev=c('png', 'pdf'), eval=F}

calPlot_list <- lapply(levels(meta_rna$cluster), function(clust,ge,mat,meta){
  cell <- rownames(meta_rna)[meta_rna$cluster==clust]
  exp <- mat[ge,cell]
  exp2 <- apply(exp,1,mean)
  return(exp2)},mark_ge,count,meta_rna)

names(calPlot_list) <- levels(meta_rna$cluster)
calPlot_dat <- do.call(cbind,calPlot_list)
calPlot_dat <- calPlot_dat[!matrixStats::rowSds(calPlot_dat) == 0,]


colors <- colorRampPalette(c('blue', 'white', 'red'))(800)
breaksList = seq(-4, 4, by = 0.01)
pheatmap(calPlot_dat, scale = "row", cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         breaks = breaksList,
         color = colors)


```

# Fig 3C

-   RNA/ATAC at top DGE
ARC LepR clusters (0/3) and PVH Cluster 

## ARC

```{r}

seu <- subset(ARC, tech=="RNA")

ARC_files <- dir("../Data.Objects/dge/results.ARC", pattern=".txt", full.names = T)
ARC_tabs <- lapply(ARC_files, read.delim)
names(ARC_tabs) <- gsub("../Data.Objects/dge/results.ARC/glimma_obs-|_results_file.txt","",ARC_files)

clust_test <- levels(seu$cluster)
clust_test <- clust_test[clust_test %in% names(ARC_tabs)]

#export all the gene lists that are sinificant only
all_genes <- lapply(clust_test, function(x){

  sig <- ARC_tabs[[x]]
  sig$padjust <- p.adjust(ARC_tabs[[x]]$F.p.value)
  return(sig)
  
})
names(all_genes) <- paste0("Cluster.",as.character(clust_test))
rio::export(all_genes, "tables/ARC.dge_res_byclust.xlsx")

# export the gene lists that are sinificant only
all_genes <- lapply(clust_test, function(x){

  sig <- ARC_tabs[[x]]
  sig$padjust <- p.adjust(ARC_tabs[[x]]$F.p.value)
  sig <- sig[sig$padjust < 0.05,]                      
  return(sig)
  
})
names(all_genes) <- paste0("Cluster.",as.character(clust_test))
rio::export(all_genes, "tables/ARC.dge_res_byclust_justsig.xlsx")

# extract the genes ids of significant                    
ids <- lapply(clust_test, function(x){

  sig <- ARC_tabs[[x]]
  sig$padjust <- p.adjust(ARC_tabs[[x]]$F.p.value)
  sig <- sig[sig$padjust < 0.05,]                      
  goi <- sig$Genes
  return(goi)
  
})

names(ids) <- as.character(clust_test)

```

```{R}
# this is adapted from internal function in seurat

Melt <- function(x) {
  if (!is.data.frame(x = x)) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x = x)
  }
  return(data.frame(
    rows = rep.int(x = rownames(x = x), times = ncol(x = x)),
    cols = unlist(x = lapply(X = colnames(x = x), FUN = rep.int, times = nrow(x = x))),
    vals = unlist(x = x, use.names = FALSE)
  ))
}


```

### ATAC

```{R, fig3C.ARC.ATAC.dge.heatmap_unordered, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, dev=c('png', 'pdf'), fig.path='figures/figure3/fig3C.heatmaps/'}

seu <- subset(ARC, tech=="ATAC")

for.plots <- names(ids)
  #names(ids)[!names(ids) %in% c("16","18")]

clust_ord <- lapply(for.plots, function(y){
  print(y)
  
  seu_temp <- seu[which(rownames(seu) %in% ids[[y]])]

  # make array of count data
  data <- as.data.frame(x = as.matrix(GetAssayData(object = seu_temp, slot = "data")))
  data2 <- Melt(x = t(x = data))
  data3 <- pivot_wider(data2, names_from = cols, values_from = vals)
  data3 <- as.data.frame(data3 )
  rownames(data3 ) <- data3 %>% pull(1)
  data3 <- data3[,-1]
  data3 <- t(data3)
  
  # grab metadata  
  my_meta <- data.frame(seu_temp$cluster, seu_temp$group, seu_temp$tech)
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::filter(my_meta$seu_temp.tech == "ATAC")
  colnames(my_meta)[1:2] <-  c("cluster", "group")
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC3h", "lep3h", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC24h", "lep24h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC72h", "lep72h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "Leptin3hr", "lep3h", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "Leptin24hr", "lep24h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "Leptin72hr", "lep72h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "ob", "OB", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "wt", "WT", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- factor(my_meta[,2], levels=c("OB","lep3h","lep24h","lep72h","WT"))
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::arrange(cluster, group)
  my_meta_sub <- my_meta %>% filter(cluster %in% y)
  my_meta_sub[,3] <- NULL
  
  # reorder data to match the metadata
  data3_sub <- data3[,colnames(data3) %in% rownames(my_meta_sub)]
  for_plot <- data3_sub[,match(rownames(my_meta_sub),colnames(data3_sub))] 
  
  # plotting parameters
  colors <- colorRampPalette(c('blue', 'white', 'red'))(800)
  breaksList = seq(-4, 4, by = 0.01)
  
  # filter rows with no counts
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot[!rowSums(for_plot)==0,]
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot_sub[apply(is.finite(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot_sub[apply(!is.na(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]

  if(nrow(for_plot_sub)>0){
  
  # first plot is for all genes and all cells
    p1 <- pheatmap(for_plot_sub,
                    main=paste0("Relative ATAC accesiblity at DGE in cluster ",y,"\n All cells are shown"),
                    scale = "row",
                    annotation_col = my_meta_sub,
                    show_rownames = F,
                    cluster_cols = F,
                    show_colnames = F,
                    labels_row = NULL,
                    treeheight_row=20,
                    breaks = breaksList,
                    color = colors)

    p1

    grps <- unique(my_meta_sub)

# aggregate counts per cluster
    for_plot2 <- sapply(1:nrow(grps), function(x){
      for_out <- rowMeans(for_plot_sub[,which(my_meta_sub[,1] == grps[x,1] & my_meta_sub[,2] == grps[x,2])])
      return(for_out)
    })

    colnames(for_plot2) <- apply(grps,1,paste0,collapse="_")
    rownames(grps) <- colnames(for_plot2)
    
    
  # plotting parameters
  colors <- colorRampPalette(c('blue', 'white', 'red'))(400)
  breaksList = seq(-2, 2, by = 0.01)

  p2 <-  pheatmap(for_plot2,
                  main=paste0("Relative ATAC accesiblity at DGE in cluster ",y,"\n Expression aggregated within group"),
                  scale = "row",
                  annotation_col = grps,
                  show_rownames = F,
                  cluster_cols = F,
                  show_colnames = F,
                  treeheight_row=20,
                  labels_row = NULL,
                  breaks = breaksList,
                  color = colors)

  p2

  idx <- apply(for_plot2[, c(1,4,5)], 1, var) != 0

  p3 <-  pheatmap(for_plot2[idx, c(1,4,5)],
                  main=paste0("Relative ATAC accesiblity at DGE in cluster ",y,"\n Expression aggregated within group\n subset of groups shown"),
                  scale = "row",
                  annotation_col = grps[c(1,4,5),],
                  show_rownames = F,
                  cluster_cols = F,
                  show_colnames = F,
                  treeheight_row=20,
                  labels_row = NULL,
                  breaks = breaksList,
                  color = colors)

  p3

#p3_ord <- p3$tree_row$order
  
  p1_ord <- p1$tree_row$order
  names(p1_ord) <- rownames(for_plot_sub)
  p2_ord <- p2$tree_row$order
  names(p2_ord) <- rownames(for_plot2)
  p3_ord <- p3$tree_row$order
  names(p3_ord) <- rownames(for_plot2)[idx]

  clust_ord <- list(
           "p1_ord"= p1_ord,
           "p2_ord"= p2_ord,
           "p3_ord"= p3_ord)

  return(clust_ord)

  }else{cat("cluster ",y, " sig dge have no accesiblity")}
  
})

names(clust_ord) <- for.plots 

```

```{R, fig3C.ARC.RNA.dge.heatmap_unordered, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, dev=c('png', 'pdf'), fig.path='figures/figure3/fig3C.heatmaps/'}
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC3h", "lep3h", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC24h", "lep24h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC72h", "lep72h", my_meta[,2])
```

```{R, fig3C.ARC.RNA.ATAC.co-ordered.dge.heatmap, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, dev=c('png', 'pdf'), fig.path='figures/figure3/fig3C.heatmaps/',  eval=F}
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "wt", "WT", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- factor(my_meta[,2], levels=c("OB","lep3h","lep24h","lep72h","WT"))
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::arrange(cluster, group)
  my_meta_sub <- my_meta %>% filter(cluster %in% y)
  my_meta_sub[,3] <- NULL
  my_meta_sub_rna <- my_meta_sub
   
  # reorder data to match the metadata
  data3_sub <- data3[,colnames(data3) %in% rownames(my_meta_sub)]
  for_plot <- data3_sub[,match(rownames(my_meta_sub),colnames(data3_sub))] 
  
  # filter rows with no counts
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot[!rowSums(for_plot)==0,]
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot_sub[apply(is.finite(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot_sub[apply(!is.na(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]
  for_plot_sub_rna <- for_plot_sub

  # make array of count data - ATAC
  seu_temp <- seu_atac_temp
  data <- as.data.frame(x = as.matrix(GetAssayData(object = seu_temp, slot = "data")))
  data2 <- Melt(x = t(x = data))
  data3 <- pivot_wider(data2, names_from = cols, values_from = vals)
  data3 <- as.data.frame(data3 )
  rownames(data3 ) <- data3 %>% pull(1)
  data3 <- data3[,-1]
  data3 <- t(data3)
  
  # grab metadata  
  my_meta <- data.frame(seu_temp$cluster, seu_temp$condition, seu_temp$tech)
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::filter(my_meta$seu_temp.tech == "ATAC")
  colnames(my_meta)[1:2] <-  c("cluster", "group")
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC3h", "lep3h", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC24h", "lep24h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC72h", "lep72h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "ob", "OB", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "wt", "WT", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- factor(my_meta[,2], levels=c("OB","lep3h","lep24h","lep72h","WT"))
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::arrange(cluster, group)
  my_meta_sub <- my_meta %>% filter(cluster %in% y)
  my_meta_sub[,3] <- NULL
  my_meta_sub_atac <- my_meta_sub
  
  # reorder data to match the metadata
  data3_sub <- data3[,colnames(data3) %in% rownames(my_meta_sub)]
  for_plot <- data3_sub[,match(rownames(my_meta_sub),colnames(data3_sub))] 
  
  # filter rows with no counts
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot[!rowSums(for_plot)==0,]
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot_sub[apply(is.finite(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot_sub[apply(!is.na(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]
  for_plot_sub_atac <- for_plot_sub  
  
  gene_names <- intersect(rownames(for_plot_sub_atac), rownames(for_plot_sub_rna))
  
  for_plot_sub_atac <- for_plot_sub_atac[rownames(for_plot_sub_atac) %in% gene_names,]
  
  for_plot_sub_rna <- for_plot_sub_rna[rownames(for_plot_sub_rna) %in% gene_names,]
  
  # plotting parameters
  colors <- colorRampPalette(c('blue', 'white', 'red'))(800)
  breaksList = seq(-4, 4, by = 0.01)

  if(nrow(for_plot_sub_rna )>0){
  
  # first plot is for all genes and all cells
    p1 <-  pheatmap(for_plot_sub_rna,
                    main=paste0("Relative Gene Expression at DGE in cluster ",y,"\n Consistent gene order is shown"),
                    scale = "row",
                    annotation_col = my_meta_sub_rna,
                    show_rownames = F,
                    cluster_cols = F,
                    show_colnames = F,
                    labels_row = NULL,
                    treeheight_row=20,
                    breaks = breaksList,
                    color = colors)

     print(p1)
    p1_ord <- p1$tree_row$order
    
    names_ord <- rownames(for_plot_sub_rna)[p1_ord]
    
    for_plot_sub_atac <- for_plot_sub_atac[match(names_ord, rownames(for_plot_sub_atac)),]

                    show_rownames = F,
                    cluster_cols = F,
                    cluster_rows = F,
                    show_colnames = F,
                    labels_row = NULL,
                    treeheight_row=20,
                    breaks = breaksList,
                    color = colors)

     print(p1b)

    
    

    grps <- unique(my_meta_sub_rna)

# aggregate counts per cluster
    for_plot2 <- sapply(1:nrow(grps), function(x){
      for_out <- rowMeans(for_plot_sub_rna[,which(my_meta_sub_rna[,1] == grps[x,1] & my_meta_sub_rna[,2] == grps[x,2])])
      return(for_out)
    })

    colnames(for_plot2) <- apply(grps,1,paste0,collapse="_")
    rownames(grps) <- colnames(for_plot2)
  
  for_plot2_rna <- for_plot2
  grps_rna <- grps
  
  
     grps <- unique(my_meta_sub_atac)

# aggregate counts per cluster
    for_plot2 <- sapply(1:nrow(grps), function(x){

      return(for_out)
    })

    colnames(for_plot2) <- apply(grps,1,paste0,collapse="_")

  for_plot2_atac <- for_plot2
  grps_atac <- grps
    
  # plotting parameters
  colors <- colorRampPalette(c('blue', 'white', 'red'))(400)
  breaksList = seq(-2, 2, by = 0.01)

  p2 <-  pheatmap(for_plot2_rna,
                  main=paste0("Relative Gene Expression at DGE in cluster ",y,"\n Expression aggregated within group\n  Consistent gene order is shown"),
                  scale = "row",
                  annotation_col = grps_rna,
                  show_rownames = F,
                  cluster_cols = F,
                  show_colnames = F,
                  treeheight_row=20,
                  labels_row = NULL,
                  breaks = breaksList,

   print(p2)
```

## PVH

```{r}

dir.create("tables")

seu <- subset(PVH, tech=="RNA")

PVH_files <- dir("../Data.Objects/dge/results.PVH", pattern=".txt", full.names = T)
PVH_tabs <- lapply(PVH_files, read.delim)
names(PVH_tabs) <- gsub("../Data.Objects/dge/results.PVH/glimma_obs-|_results_file.txt","",PVH_files)

clust_test <- levels(seu$cluster)
clust_test <- clust_test[clust_test %in% names(PVH_tabs)]

#export all the gene lists that are sinificant only
all_genes <- lapply(clust_test, function(x){

  sig <- PVH_tabs[[x]]
  sig$padjust <- p.adjust(PVH_tabs[[x]]$F.p.value)
  return(sig)
  
})
names(all_genes) <- paste0("Cluster.",as.character(clust_test))
rio::export(all_genes, "tables/PVH.dge_res_byclust.xlsx")

# export the gene lists that are sinificant only
all_genes <- lapply(clust_test, function(x){

  sig <- PVH_tabs[[x]]
  sig$padjust <- p.adjust(PVH_tabs[[x]]$F.p.value)
  sig <- sig[sig$padjust < 0.05,]                      
  return(sig)
  
})
names(all_genes) <- paste0("Cluster.",as.character(clust_test))
rio::export(all_genes, "tables/PVH.dge_res_byclust_justsig.xlsx")

# extract the genes ids of significant                    
ids <- lapply(clust_test, function(x){

  sig <- PVH_tabs[[x]]
  sig$padjust <- p.adjust(PVH_tabs[[x]]$F.p.value)
  sig <- sig[sig$padjust < 0.05,]                      
  goi <- sig$Genes
  return(goi)
  
})

names(ids) <- as.character(clust_test)
```

### ATAC

```{R, fig3C.PVH.ATAC.dge.heatmap_unordered, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, dev=c('png', 'pdf'), fig.path='figures/figure3/fig3C.heatmaps/'}

seu <- subset(PVH, tech=="ATAC")

for.plots <- names(ids)#[!names(ids) %in% c("16","18")]

clust_ord <- lapply(for.plots, function(y){
  print(y)
  
  seu_temp <- seu[which(rownames(seu) %in% ids[[y]])]

  # make array of count data
  data <- as.data.frame(x = as.matrix(GetAssayData(object = seu_temp, slot = "data")))
  data2 <- Melt(x = t(x = data))
  data3 <- pivot_wider(data2, names_from = cols, values_from = vals)
  data3 <- as.data.frame(data3 )
  rownames(data3 ) <- data3 %>% pull(1)
  data3 <- data3[,-1]
  data3 <- t(data3)
  
  # grab metadata  
  my_meta <- data.frame(seu_temp$cluster, seu_temp$condition, seu_temp$tech)
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::filter(my_meta$seu_temp.tech == "ATAC")
  colnames(my_meta)[1:2] <-  c("cluster", "group")
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC3h", "lep3h", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC24h", "lep24h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC72h", "lep72h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "ob", "OB", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "wt", "WT", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- factor(my_meta[,2], levels=c("OB","lep3h","lep24h","lep72h","WT"))
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::arrange(cluster, group)
  my_meta_sub <- my_meta %>% filter(cluster %in% y)
  my_meta_sub[,3] <- NULL
  
  # reorder data to match the metadata
  data3_sub <- data3[,colnames(data3) %in% rownames(my_meta_sub)]
  for_plot <- data3_sub[,match(rownames(my_meta_sub),colnames(data3_sub))] 
  
  # plotting parameters
  colors <- colorRampPalette(c('blue', 'white', 'red'))(800)
  breaksList = seq(-4, 4, by = 0.01)
  
  # filter rows with no counts
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot[!rowSums(for_plot)==0,]
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot_sub[apply(is.finite(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot_sub[apply(!is.na(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]

  if(nrow(for_plot_sub)>0){
  
  # first plot is for all genes and all cells
    p1 <- pheatmap(for_plot_sub,
                    main=paste0("Relative ATAC accesiblity at DGE in cluster ",y,"\n All cells are shown"),
                    scale = "row",
                    annotation_col = my_meta_sub,
                    show_rownames = F,
                    cluster_cols = F,
                    show_colnames = F,
                    labels_row = NULL,
                    treeheight_row=20,
                    breaks = breaksList,
                    color = colors)

    p1

    grps <- unique(my_meta_sub)

# aggregate counts per cluster
    for_plot2 <- sapply(1:nrow(grps), function(x){
      for_out <- rowMeans(for_plot_sub[,which(my_meta_sub[,1] == grps[x,1] & my_meta_sub[,2] == grps[x,2])])
      return(for_out)
    })

    colnames(for_plot2) <- apply(grps,1,paste0,collapse="_")
    rownames(grps) <- colnames(for_plot2)
    
    
  # plotting parameters
  colors <- colorRampPalette(c('blue', 'white', 'red'))(400)
  breaksList = seq(-2, 2, by = 0.01)

  p2 <-  pheatmap(for_plot2,
                  main=paste0("Relative ATAC accesiblity at DGE in cluster ",y,"\n Expression aggregated within group"),
                  scale = "row",
                  annotation_col = grps,
                  show_rownames = F,
                  cluster_cols = F,
                  show_colnames = F,
                  treeheight_row=20,
                  labels_row = NULL,
                  breaks = breaksList,
                  color = colors)

  p2

  idx <- apply(for_plot2[, c(1,4,5)], 1, var) != 0

  p3 <-  pheatmap(for_plot2[idx, c(1,4,5)],
                  main=paste0("Relative ATAC accesiblity at DGE in cluster ",y,"\n Expression aggregated within group\n subset of groups shown"),
                  scale = "row",
                  annotation_col = grps[c(1,4,5),],
                  show_rownames = F,
                  cluster_cols = F,
                  show_colnames = F,
                  treeheight_row=20,
                  labels_row = NULL,
                  breaks = breaksList,
                  color = colors)

  p3

#p3_ord <- p3$tree_row$order
  
  p1_ord <- p1$tree_row$order
  names(p1_ord) <- rownames(for_plot_sub)
  p2_ord <- p2$tree_row$order
  names(p2_ord) <- rownames(for_plot2)
  p3_ord <- p3$tree_row$order
  names(p3_ord) <- rownames(for_plot2)[idx]

  clust_ord <- list(
           "p1_ord"= p1_ord,
           "p2_ord"= p2_ord,
           "p3_ord"= p3_ord)

  return(clust_ord)

  }else{cat("cluster ",y, " sig dge have no accesiblity")}
  
})

names(clust_ord) <- for.plots
```

```{R, fig3C.PVH.RNA.ATAC.co-ordered.dge.heatmap, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, dev=c('png', 'pdf'), fig.path='figures/figure3/fig3C.heatmaps/'}
  my_meta <- data.frame(seu_temp$cluster, seu_temp$condition, seu_temp$tech)
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::filter(my_meta$seu_temp.tech == "ATAC")
  colnames(my_meta)[1:2] <-  c("cluster", "group")
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC3h", "lep3h", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC24h", "lep24h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC72h", "lep72h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "ob", "OB", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "wt", "WT", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- factor(my_meta[,2], levels=c("OB","lep3h","lep24h","lep72h","WT"))
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::arrange(cluster, group)
  my_meta_sub <- my_meta %>% filter(cluster %in% y)
  my_meta_sub[,3] <- NULL
  my_meta_sub_atac <- my_meta_sub
  
  # reorder data to match the metadata
  data3_sub <- data3[,colnames(data3) %in% rownames(my_meta_sub)]
  for_plot <- data3_sub[,match(rownames(my_meta_sub),colnames(data3_sub))] 
  
  # filter rows with no counts
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot[!rowSums(for_plot)==0,]
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot_sub[apply(is.finite(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot_sub[apply(!is.na(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]
  for_plot_sub_atac <- for_plot_sub  
  
  gene_names <- intersect(rownames(for_plot_sub_atac), rownames(for_plot_sub_rna))
  
  for_plot_sub_atac <- for_plot_sub_atac[rownames(for_plot_sub_atac) %in% gene_names,]
  
  for_plot_sub_rna <- for_plot_sub_rna[rownames(for_plot_sub_rna) %in% gene_names,]
  
  # plotting parameters
  colors <- colorRampPalette(c('blue', 'white', 'red'))(800)
  breaksList = seq(-4, 4, by = 0.01)

  if(nrow(for_plot_sub_rna )>0){
  
  # first plot is for all genes and all cells

                    main=paste0("Relative Gene Expression at DGE in cluster ",y,"\n Consistent gene order is shown"),
                    scale = "row",

                    show_rownames = F,
                    cluster_cols = F,
                    show_colnames = F,
                    labels_row = NULL,
                    treeheight_row=20,
                    breaks = breaksList,
                    color = colors)

     print(p1)

    p1b <-  pheatmap(for_plot_sub_atac,
                    main=paste0("Relative Gene Activity at DGE in cluster ",y,"\n Consistent gene order is shown"),
                    scale = "row",
                    annotation_col = my_meta_sub_atac,
                    show_rownames = F,
                    cluster_cols = F,
                    cluster_rows = F,
                    show_colnames = F,
                    labels_row = NULL,
                    treeheight_row=20,
                    breaks = breaksList,
                    color = colors)

     print(p1b)

    
    

    grps <- unique(my_meta_sub_rna)

# aggregate counts per cluster
    for_plot2 <- sapply(1:nrow(grps), function(x){
      for_out <- rowMeans(for_plot_sub_rna[,which(my_meta_sub_rna[,1] == grps[x,1] & my_meta_sub_rna[,2] == grps[x,2])])
      return(for_out)

  grps_rna <- grps
  
  
     grps <- unique(my_meta_sub_atac)

# aggregate counts per cluster
    for_plot2 <- sapply(1:nrow(grps), function(x){

   print(p2)
```

```{r}

custom_footprint_plot2 <- function (object, features, assay = NULL, group.by = NULL, split.by = NULL, 
    idents = NULL, label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, show.expected = TRUE, 
    normalization = "subtract", label.top = 3, label.idents = NULL){
  

    assay <- Signac:::SetIfNull(x = assay, y = Seurat::DefaultAssay(object = object))
    splitby_str <- "__signac_tmp__"
    if (!is.null(x = split.by)) {
        if (is.null(x = group.by)) {
            grouping.var <- Idents(object = object)
        }
        else {
            grouping.var <- object[[group.by]][, 1]
        }
        combined.var <- paste0(object[[split.by]][, 1], splitby_str, 
            grouping.var)
        object$grouping_tmp <- combined.var
        group.by <- "grouping_tmp"
        if (!is.null(x = idents)) {
            idents.keep <- combined.var[grouping.var %in% idents]
            idents <- unique(x = idents.keep)
        }
    }
    
    plot.data <- GetFootprintData(object = object, features = features, 
        assay = assay, group.by = group.by, idents = idents)
    plot.data %<>% dplyr::filter(abs(position)<=200)
    
    motif.sizes <- Signac:::GetMotifSize(object = object, features = features, 
        assay = assay)
    obs <- plot.data[plot.data$class == "Observed", ]
    expect <- plot.data[plot.data$class == "Expected", ]
    base <- ceiling(motif.sizes/2)
    obs$flanks <- sapply(X = seq_len(length.out = nrow(x = obs)), 
        FUN = function(x) {
            pos <- abs(obs[x, "position"])
            size <- base[[obs[x, "feature"]]]
            return((pos > size) & (pos < (size + 50)))
        })
    if (!is.null(normalization)) {
        correction.vec <- expect$norm.value
        names(correction.vec) <- paste(expect$position, expect$feature)
        if (normalization == "subtract") {
            obs$norm.value <- obs$norm.value - correction.vec[paste(obs$position, 
                obs$feature)]
        }
        else if (normalization == "divide") {
            obs$norm.value <- obs$norm.value/correction.vec[paste(obs$position, 
                obs$feature)]
        }
        else {
            stop("Unknown normalization method requested")
        }
    }
    if (!is.null(x = split.by)) {
        splitvar <- strsplit(x = obs[["group"]], split = splitby_str)
        obs[["group"]] <- sapply(X = splitvar, FUN = `[[`, 2)
        obs[["split"]] <- sapply(X = splitvar, FUN = `[[`, 1)
    }
    flanks <- obs[obs$flanks, ]
    flanks <- group_by(.data = flanks, feature, group)
    flankmeans <- summarize(.data = flanks, mn = mean(x = norm.value))
    topmean <- top_n(x = flankmeans, n = label.top, wt = mn)
    ymax <- top_n(x = flankmeans, n = 1, wt = mn)
    ymin <- top_n(x = flankmeans, n = 1, wt = -mn)
    label.df <- data.frame()
    sub <- obs[obs$position == 75, ]
    for (i in seq_along(along.with = features)) {
        if (is.null(x = label.idents)) {
            groups.use <- topmean[topmean$feature == features[[i]], 
                ]$group
        }
        else {
            groups.use <- label.idents
        }
        df.sub <- sub[(sub$feature == features[[i]]) & (sub$group %in% 
            groups.use), ]
        label.df <- rbind(label.df, df.sub)
    }
    obs$label <- NA
    label.df$label <- label.df$group
    obs <- rbind(obs, label.df)
    plotlist <- list()

        df <- obs[obs$feature == features[[i]], ]
        
        final_mat <- lapply(1:length(unique(df$group)),function(x){

        df_temp <- df %>% filter(group==unique(df$group)[x]) %>%
          group_by(position) %>%
          summarise(mean_norm=mean(norm.value))
        df_temp$mean_norm_slide <- df_temp %>% pull(mean_norm) %>% slide_dbl(~mean(.x), .before = 2, .after = 2)
        df_temp$group <- unique(df$group)[x]
        df_temp$split <- unique(df$group)[x]
        
        return(df_temp)
          })
        
        df <- do.call("rbind",final_mat)
        
        min.use <- ifelse(test = normalization == "subtract", 
            yes = -0.5, no = 0.5)
        axis.min <- range(df$mean_norm_slide)[1]-dist(range(df$mean_norm_slide))/10
        axis.max <- range(df$mean_norm_slide)[2]+dist(range(df$mean_norm_slide))/10
        p <- ggplot(data = df, mapping = aes(x = position, y = mean_norm_slide, 
            color = group))
        p <- p + geom_line(size = 0.2) + xlab("Distance from motif") + 
            ylab(label = "Tn5 insertion\nenrichment") + theme_classic() + 
            ggtitle(label = features[[i]]) + ylim(c(axis.min, 
            axis.max)) + guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1)))
        if (!is.null(x = split.by)) {
            p <- p + facet_wrap(facets = ~split)
        }
        
        return(p)
        
}
```

```{r}
    base <- ceiling(motif.sizes/2)
    
    obs$flanks <- sapply(X = seq_len(length.out = nrow(x = obs)), 
        FUN = function(x) {
            pos <- abs(obs[x, "position"])
            size <- base[[obs[x, "feature"]]]
            return((pos > size) & (pos < (size + 50)))
        })
    
    if (!is.null(normalization)) {
        correction.vec <- expect$norm.value
        names(correction.vec) <- paste(expect$position, expect$feature)
        if (normalization == "subtract") {
            obs$norm.value <- obs$norm.value - correction.vec[paste(obs$position, 
                obs$feature)]
        } else if (normalization == "divide") {
            obs$norm.value <- obs$norm.value/correction.vec[paste(obs$position, 
                obs$feature)]
        }
        else {
            stop("Unknown normalization method requested")
        }
    }
    
    if (!is.null(x = split.by)) {
        splitvar <- strsplit(x = obs[["group"]], split = splitby_str)
        obs[["group"]] <- sapply(X = splitvar, FUN = `[[`, 2)
        obs[["split"]] <- sapply(X = splitvar, FUN = `[[`, 1)
    }
    
    flanks <- obs[obs$flanks, ]
    flanks <- group_by(.data = flanks, feature, group)
    flankmeans <- summarize(.data = flanks, mn = mean(x = norm.value))
    topmean <- top_n(x = flankmeans, n = label.top, wt = mn)
    ymax <- top_n(x = flankmeans, n = 1, wt = mn)
    ymin <- top_n(x = flankmeans, n = 1, wt = -mn)
    label.df <- data.frame()
    sub <- obs[obs$position == 75, ]
    
    for (i in seq_along(along.with = features)) {
        if (is.null(x = label.idents)) {
            groups.use <- topmean[topmean$feature == features[[i]], 
                ]$group
        } else {
            groups.use <- label.idents
        }
        df.sub <- sub[(sub$feature == features[[i]]) & (sub$group %in% 
            groups.use), ]
        label.df <- rbind(label.df, df.sub)
    }
    
    obs$label <- NA
    label.df$label <- label.df$group
    obs <- rbind(obs, label.df)
    plotlist <- list()

    df <- obs[obs$feature == features[[i]], ]
        
        final_mat <- lapply(1:length(unique(df$group)),function(x){

        df_temp <- df %>% filter(group==unique(df$group)[x]) %>%
          group_by(position) %>%
          summarise(mean_norm=mean(norm.value))
        df_temp$mean_norm_slide <- df_temp %>% pull(mean_norm) %>% slide_dbl(~mean(.x), .before = 7, .after = 7)
        df_temp$group <- unique(df$group)[x]
        df_temp$split <- unique(df$group)[x]
        
        df_temp <- dplyr::filter(df_temp,abs(position)<101)
        
        return(df_temp)
          })
        
        df <- do.call("rbind",final_mat)
        
        min.use <- ifelse(test = normalization == "subtract", 
            yes = -0.5, no = 0.5)
        axis.min <- range(df$mean_norm_slide)[1]-dist(range(df$mean_norm_slide))/10
        axis.max <- range(df$mean_norm_slide)[2]+dist(range(df$mean_norm_slide))/10
        
  df <- dplyr::filter(df, group %in% c("WT", "OB","Leptin72hr"))
        
        p <- ggplot(data = df, mapping = aes(x = position, y = mean_norm_slide, 
            color = group, size= group, linetype = group)) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c("WT" = 1, "OB" = 1.5, "Leptin72hr"= 2)) + scale_linetype_manual(values = c("WT" = "longdash", "OB" = "dotdash", "Leptin72hr"= "solid"))
        
        p <- p + geom_line(size = 0.2) + xlab("Distance from motif") + 
            ylab(label = "Tn5 insertion\nenrichment") + theme_classic() + 
            ggtitle(label = features[[i]]) + ylim(c(axis.min, 
            axis.max)) + guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1)))
        if (!is.null(x = split.by)) {
            p <- p + facet_wrap(facets = ~split)
        }
        
        return(p)
        
}
```
